evidence: Film thickness was measured using X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) on a Siemens D5000 in Bragg–Brentano geometry and with CuK a radiation. The amount of deposited material was measured by X-ray ﬂuorescence (XRF Spectro X-lab 2000). Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GI-XRD) was carried out on a Phillips MRD system... Rocking curve, y–2y, and reciprocal space mapping were measured on the same Phillips MRD... Pole ﬁgures were measured on the Phillips MRD system... Carbon impurities in the ﬁlms were measured by a PHI Quantum 2000 XPS after cleaning of the ﬁlm surface by argon ion sputtering... The surface morphology and the surface roughness were measured by a Psia XEI 150 non-contact atomic force microscope (NC-AFM). Cross-sections of the ﬁlms were studied by a high-resolution FEI Tecnai F30ST transmission electron microscope (TEM).
